messages:
ajay: Kicking off a quick thread for the new AP-north-1 seed region. Need alignment on Pulumi <-> Terraform bridge, remote state, and CI wiring before we flip any provisioning. TL;DR: I have a draft module but want gating checks spelled out.

maria: thanks for starting this. can you paste the current module and where state currently lives?

ajay: pasted below — it's a thin pulumi wrapper that calls our tf-network module. state is in s3://redwood-remote-state/ap-north-1 with dynamodb lock table 'state-lock-ap-north-1'.

kevin: quick note: for this region we hit vCPU quota limits in trial runs. we should include a preflight quota check step in the pipeline (aws service-quotas get-service-quota) and fail fast with instructions.

tanya: +1 on quota check. also add a networking sanity step: ensure VPC CIDR doesn't overlap with existing hub peering (10.32.0.0/16 reserved).

ajay: agreed. proposing preflight CI job list: 
- validate-terraform (fmt, validate, plan with a zero-change run)
- preflight-quotas (script checks major quotas)
- pulumi-preview (ensure the wrapper maps correctly)
- infra-lint

sam: for state bridge: when pulumi calls TF we should keep a single source of truth for infra outputs. recommend we export the TF outputs to SSM param store under /state/ap-north-1/ to make downstream lookups idempotent.

maria: small warning: SSM param size limits — only store pointers (s3 paths + version ids), not big objects.

kevin: operational checklist for bootstrapping cluster after infra provision: 
1) node pool creation (spot + on-demand mix)
2) GPU driver install + nvidia-smi smoke test
3) kubelet readiness and custom cni checks
4) model-serving canary (small qps against a canary image)
5) cost telemetry enabled (billing tag propagation + float logs)

tanya: add network path checks: 
- peer status (aws ec2 describe-vpc-peering-connections)
- route table propagation to NATs
- SG rule sanity (no 0.0.0.0/0 on internal ports)

ajay: putting those into the runbook. also thinking about state locking: ensure the pipeline creates the dynamodb lock table as part of infra-bootstrap if missing, but gate it behind an approval for prod-like regions.

infra-bot: reminder: create ticket INFRA-9821 for dedicated KMS key usage and attach policy doc link https://wiki.redwood.io/kms-ap-north-1

sam: CI wiring notes: use self-hosted runners in us-east for heavy tf plan/apply (we don't have GPUs in us-east for this step). use ephemeral runners to avoid credential bleed. job names: ap-north-1/terraform-apply, ap-north-1/pulumi-up.

maria: can we add automated smoke validations post-apply? something that curls /health from the model-proxy and runs 3 inference calls (token-level) to verify latency and correctness. failure should trigger automatic rollback to previous model routing.

kevin: cost callout: estimate for first week (bootstrap + e2e): ~1.8k USD if using spot for workers and 2 on-demand control nodes. add a buffer for quota-driven on-demand fallbacks. include cost estimate in PR description.

ajay: ACTIONS: 
- i'll open a PR for pulumi wrapper with the preflight jobs + dynamodb bootstrap (WIP)
- tanya, please add the network peering validation script to infra-utils repo
- kevin, write the smoke test harness and cost note to the PR template
- sam, update CI job names and runner tags

tanya: acked, will push network checks by EOD.

maria: i'll prepare the runbook snippet for SRE handoff (rollback steps, escalation playbook, runbook checklist).

kevin: one more — include a soft-fallback policy in smart routing: if capacity is below threshold, route to eu-west-1 variant until ops okays. that's a behavioral config not infra.

ajay: noted. final ask: before we run apply, can someone review the IAM roles — especially the assume-role chain for the CI runner to assume the bootstrap role? want least privilege.

sam: i'll do an iam-policy quick audit and comment on the PR.

ajay: thanks all. i'll post the PR link here when ready and include a checklist that must pass before handoff. :thumbsup:
